channel.description:
Nature Communications is an open access, multidisciplinary journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in all areas of the biological, health, physical, chemical and Earth sciences. Papers published by the journal aim to represent important advances of significance to specialists within each field.

We are committed to providing an efficient service for both authors and readers. Our team of independent editors make rapid and fair publication decisions. Prompt dissemination of accepted papers to a wide readership and beyond is achieved through a programme of continuous online publication.

item.title: [6] Topological polaritons in natural uniaxial materials
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Enrico Maria Renzi, Andrea Alù

Authors: Xiang Ni, Mingsong Wang, Qijun Ma, Enrico Maria Renzi, Andrea Alù

Score 6/10 C_MAYBE

Why: Topological study using near-field microscopy on natural uniaxial crystals.

Tags: #topological #polaritons #near-field

Abstract: Recent experiments have demonstrated control of surface phonon polaritons (SPPs) in various schemes, yet their topological nature in relation to their polaritonic bands has not been explored. Here, the authors characterise drumhead-like SPPs via scattering type scanning near-field optical microscopy in uniaxial calcite, resolving their connection to topological nodal lines and demonstrating near field control.
